strings.en: This ship will finish that enemy off.
All hands, I hope to see you fight well.
This ship will take out that enemy.
We're going ahead to Osaka./　Get us out of this combat zone, fast.
Sir. Destroying enemy units in our path.
XO, withdraw from this combat zone at once.
Roger. Clearing enemy units from our path.
I can't repeat the mistake I made back then...!
XO, we're withdrawing from this combat zone now!
We can't let that man take the Cross Gate./　XO!
No life signs inside the target!
Final target: XN-L./　All hands, give it everything you've got!
XO. If that thing's a ship too, we can't fall behind it.
Yes, let's show it what this ship can do.
The deity ship's voyage ends here...!/　XO!
All hands, prepare for anti-ship combat.
XO, this ship will sink that vessel.
Captain, the Raftclans is within range.
XO, keep the enemy commander unit in check.
Keep the enemy commander unit away from this ship.
XO, we're wiping out the Lamaris in this zone, fast.
Gugh! Send the allies at Range 2 to cover us!
Kh! We have to avoid any more direct hits...!
Direct hit to the aft Tesla Drive pile!/　Output dropping!
Bow up! Hard to port, minimum radius!/　Counter with the starboard turrets!
This ship has to be the wall/　that stops Zee-Gadin here...!
However powerful the deity ship may be,/　we won't give ground here...!
...Against the Raftclans, we'll have to/　put up a barrage in every direction.
Where did we take the hit?
Bow lower control rudder!/　Force field inductor function dropping!
Direct hit on the lower blade sail, Frame 20!
They hit us at the root...!
Kh, the direct hits keep coming...?!
Things might not be going our way here.
It's not just the explosions, the shaking's violent...?!
That's because the bow control rudder took a hit.
Don't let the enemy commander unit get any closer.
Stop the Lamaris./　Don't let them get past here.
Bow booster beam capacitor! Minor damage!
Machine gun turrets, keep the enemy away.
No abnormalities reported from any section!
Good. We'll keep engaging the target.
Keep up the barrage and turn starboard to 60 degrees.
Don't let the enemy commander unit approach.
It's using the Cross Gate's power,/　and that's all it can do...?!
Emperor unit or not,/　it doesn't seem able to do much damage to this ship.
XN-L... Is that meant to keep us in check?
Put up a barrage. Don't let the Lamaris approach.
The Lamaris got their fangs into us...!
Thicken the barrage./　Don't let the Raftclans approach.
We won't be such an easy target.
Keep handling this carefully./　We're sinking XN-L here.
We've tangled with Zeranio-class ships/　plenty of times.
We won't let Golaikunru have its way.
We can't let the Lamaris possess us.
We won't let the Fury have their way.
We'll keep drawing the target's attention.
Helmsman, dodge the next one too.
...That one was a little close, huh?
Well, all's well that ends well.
...Those Dark Brain leftovers are,/　honestly, a pretty weird bunch.
The enemy will be back. Stay alert.
This ship will attack as well.
Move forward and take the hit with this ship.
Port and starboard secondary guns, fire!
Forward secondary guns, relative measurement set!
Steel 2 to all units!/　We're firing our Main Cannon!
Range data confirmed! Relative speed matched!
Upper shock cannons,/　relative ranging set!
Bow Tronium Buster Cannon,/　moving to final sequence!
Ranging complete! Clear to release FEB!
Confirmed all mobile units clear of the line of fire!
Booster beam capacitors, open!/　Final safety lock, released!
All hands, brace for impact and flash!
Steel 2 to all units!/　Buster Cannon firing in 20 seconds!
All mobile units have evacuated the line of fire!
